# Aayush Vishwakarma (Bugholic)

> Full-stack developer based in Pune, India, with 3+ years building web, mobile and AI-powered products in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and Python. Currently a Full-Stack Developer at Greenmint Labs and open for freelance work: web apps, APIs and AI integrations, remote or on-site.
